## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/...`, `bugfix/...`, `docs/...`, `hotfix/...`)
- [ ] Commit messages use conventional prefixes (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `build:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] `mvn clean verify` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets or local configuration committed
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
